title: Cheetah Robot runs 28.3 mph; a bit faster than Usain Bolt
summary: A short Boston Dynamics clip of the DARPA-funded Cheetah quadruped robot hitting 28.3 mph on a treadmill, slightly faster than Usain Bolt's fastest 20 meter split.
why: Cited as the reference example of a real fast legged robot, often to distinguish it from MIT's Cheetah.
